title: Fùxì: A Benchmark for Evaluating Language Models on Ancient Chinese Text Understanding and Generation
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge and classification of ancient Chinese texts related to Confucianism, Taoism, and Buddhism.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the religious/philosophical categories within the benchmark. General findings indicate that models perform better on comprehension tasks (e.g., multiple-choice) than on generation tasks across the ancient Chinese text corpus, which includes texts from Confucian, Taoist, and Buddhist traditions. Larger models also generally outperform smaller ones, especially on knowledge-intensive tasks.
